sample_interactions_by_severity.description: Slight delay in rate of absorption without affecting overall bioavailability.
Mild increase in rate of salicylate absorption.
Mild enhancement of central nervous system sedation.
CYP2C19 inhibition reducing active metabolite formation of clopidogrel.
Competition for renal tubular clearance increasing plasma metformin concentration.
Additive negative chronotropic effects requiring pulse rate monitoring.
CYP2D6 inhibition preventing conversion of tamoxifen to active endoxifen.
CYP3A4 inhibition increasing statin exposure and risk of rhabdomyolysis.
Reduced renal excretion causing acute methotrexate toxicity and pancytopenia.
Synergistic inhibition of coagulation and platelet aggregation causing severe hemorrhage.

7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Whenever possible, agents which may enhance the risk of hemorrhage should be discontinued prior to initiation of enoxaparin sodium therapy. These agents include medications such as: anticoagulants, platelet inhibitors including acetylsalicylic acid, salicylates, NSAIDs.
